about.title: About NextNTech.org
about.lead: Our goal is simple: kids deserve to become technology geeks.
about.p1: No payment, no paid subscription, and no paywall should ever stop a young person from learning to build the future.
about.p2: NextNTech.org is a non-profit learning platform. Every course — from your first HTML tag to full-stack development, Python, mobile apps and your first freelance job — is free, forever.
about.p3: We teach with simple text, memorable visuals, hands-on practice, and short quizzes. Your progress, streaks, correct answers and certificates are saved to your free account.
